title: PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26596v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute diverse individual manipulation skills, yet they still struggle with long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, where temporal structure, skills, and precision are tightly coupled within a monolithic model. We propose Physically Grounded Execution (PGX), a framework that offloads temporal and precision control to two classical training-free components, allowing the VLA to focus on stage-specific skill dynamics. PGX decomposes long-horizon loco-manipulation into three layers: (i) a predicate-based state machine governs task progression, using physical predicates to gate phase transitions, trigger recovery, and coordinate navigation and waiting. Shared predicate semantics connect offline demonstration segmentation, online execution, and stage-wise evaluation; (ii) VLA skills operate within active manipulation phases, with flat or stage-trained models concentrating on task-relevant action

translated_title: PGX：面向长时程人形机器人移动操作的物理接地执行框架
translated_abstract: 机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够执行多种不同的单项操作技能，但在长时程移动操作任务中仍然表现不佳，因为在这类任务中，时间结构、技能与精度紧密耦合于一个单体模型之中。我们提出了物理接地执行，这是一个将时间控制与精度控制卸载到两个经典的无需训练组件的框架，从而使VLA能够专注于特定阶段的技能动态。PGX将长时程移动操作分解为三个层次：（i）基于谓词的状态机控制任务进程，利用物理谓词来限制阶段转换、触发恢复行为，并协调导航与等待。共享的谓词语义将离线演示分割、在线执行和分阶段评估连接起来；（ii）VLA技能在活跃的操作阶段内运行，采用单一模型或分阶段训练的模型专注于与任务相关的动作。
tldr: PGX框架通过将时间结构与精度控制交由两个无需训练的经典组件处理，并把长时程人形机器人移动操作分解为谓词状态机、VLA技能执行等多层结构，使VLA模型专注于阶段特定的技能动态，从而有效解决长时程移动操作中时间、技能与精度紧密耦合的难题。
en_tdlr: PGX offloads temporal and precision control to two classical training-free components—a predicate-based state machine and hierarchical task decomposition—allowing VLA models to focus on stage-specific skill dynamics for long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation.
